title: Black Bean Dip with Feta & Bell Pepper Chips

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallots and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, and jalapeño; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a blender.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the blender along with water and spices.
When the sautéed veggies are soft, add to the blender. Blend on high until semi-smooth, adding more water, 1-2 tablespoons at a time, if needed.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the blender and process once more until just combined. Set aside.
Cut bell peppers lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Slice each quarter crosswise into 3-4 pieces to make the "chips."
Divide black bean dip between plates and sprinkle with feta. Serve with bell pepper "chips" on the side.
